reason: V0.3.9 passed the complete reset/paired-state/visibility audit and 8/9 scripted-expert cells. Attempts 0 and 2 satisfied every component of the original place_can_basket.check_success predicate but were rejected only by V0.3.9's additional full-AABB gate; attempt 1 was a genuine placement failure. The requirement explicitly asks to reuse the native parent success condition. V0.3.10 therefore makes exact place_can_basket.check_success(self) the instantaneous gate and retains the already preregistered 25-real-physics-step persistence wrapper. Full-AABB, release, and relative-motion measurements remain non-gating diagnostics. instruction: Put the can into the basket.
